text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert fired - routing-latency-surge (prod-router). Trigger: 5xx_ratio > 1% over 1m. Pager: @oncall_ryan :rotating_light:

oncall_ryan: acked. looking into it now. rough ETA 10m to triage.

sre_maya: on it too — dashboards show a brief spike in latency and an increase in ephemeral connection errors from router-5 in us-east-1. opening logs now.

oncall_ryan: seeing elevated tail latencies on the routing tier, p95 jumped ~400ms at ~00:18UTC. not many 5xxs though. could be KV cache thrash or a noisy node.

sre_maya: agree. quick note: there was a small canary deployment on the routing service ~00:15UTC. possible correlation.

oncall_ryan: i'm going to drain router-5 from LB and force fallback to the healthy pool. running runbook step 2.

ops-bot: automated mitigation: initiating drain for router-5 (instance id i-0a1b2c3d) and enabling fallback routing policy.

oncall_ryan: command used:
```bash
kubectl cordon router-5 -n inference
kubectl drain router-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference
```

eng_lead_zoe: any customer-visible errors reported? CX pinged that one customer saw a slow response in chat, no error pages. sounds like degraded latency only.

sre_maya: checking traces — span durations align with routing queueing on that node. no increased 5xxs for customers, just higher latency for a small % of requests. looks contained.

oncall_ryan: also applied temporary concurrency throttle on the heavy route (generation-stream) to reduce amplification while we stabilize.

sre_maya: metrics stabilizing. p95 back to baseline within ~2m of drain. KV hit-rate recovered, suggests cold cache on that instance.

incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved (routing-latency-surge) at 00:24UTC — condition cleared.

oncall_ryan: good to see auto-resolve. keeping this thread open for a quick handoff and follow-up. handing to @sre_maya to investigate root cause and file any follow-up.

sre_maya: taking it. preliminary triage: noisy canary with higher initialization CPU causing transient queueing and KV cold misses. will pull more logs and correlate with deployment timeline. posting a short timeline and action items in #postmortems if there's customer impact.

eng_lead_zoe: thanks everyone. no immediate customer-facing impact identified, but please add a runbook step to detect canary-induced routing noise and consider staggering canary traffic more. :thumbsup:

oncall_ryan: noting runbook edit and tagging this as a low-sev transient flare. closing on-call action.

ops-bot: mitigation actions completed: router-5 drained, fallback disabled, throttle removed.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident cleared at 00:30UTC.

sre_maya: will follow up tomorrow with RCA draft and whether we need a small postmortem. thanks for quick responses — nice and brief. :tada:
